meta.name: Me
meta.description:
In twenty-two nearly wordless minutes, a musical plays out about a self absorbing everything it touches. His newest: a round character rolls through a hand-drawn world converting people, places and finally the film itself into more of himself. After thirty years of drawing other people's inner lives, this is the one about the ego as a closed system — a self that only ever takes in more of itself.

A musical odyssey about generational trauma and the retreat of humanity into itself.
